$comment: Single description of the harness hooks. Lane C turns `hooks` into the plugin hooks/hooks.json and into project-level settings. `script` is relative to the repo root (the plugin root once assembled); run it with node, passing `args`. `default` is the state a fresh install gets. `blocking` is true when the script can exit 2 or deny. Every script fails open and has an off switch (`disable`). `commands` are not hooks: they are run by hand or by the agents.

hooks.description: Denies clearly destructive shell commands (force push to the default branch, rm -r of the repo root or home, reset --hard on a dirty tree, publish and deploy) plus your own rules from agents.config.json.
Blocks a whole Read of a text file over 40 KB and tells the agent to grep and read a line range instead.
Adds one reminder to save progress to the state file and build log when session context passes 150k tokens.
Auto-approves Monitor watches whose command is provably read-only. Never denies. Off by default because it changes permission prompts.
Makes whole-repo jobs (full verify, typecheck, native builds) take turns, and waits while memory pressure is critical. Only delays; never denies.
Releases the lane entry that heavy-gate-pre registered. Enable both heavy-gate hooks together.
Reports finished packet runs and starts the next queued packet in a detached headless session. Off by default because it starts agent runs.

commands.description: Run one packet in a fresh headless session (optionally in a git worktree).
Cut one packet's brief and spec into a small slice file; check slices are current.
Write or read one packet's row and round entry in a build log.
Queue every packet of a brief with its dependencies.
Cheap mechanical check of just-edited files.
Remove finished packet worktrees (branches are kept).
Print one value of agents.config.json for shell scripts.
Print only the rows of a markdown status file that changed since the last run.
Run one whole-repo job in the shared one-at-a-time lane.
Print OK or WAIT from the OS memory pressure level.
